name: Necromancer bench: Command: Abomination lets a commanded kill give experience with no swing
contract: SoloKill.RequirePlayerHit (#10365) gives an ungrouped player experience from a creature only if the player registered a hit on it. Order() (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:405) drives the minion but may not register that hit. Raise: Abomination 500335 (3 Life Force) summons creature 50068; its capacity needs Scourge Apprentice Training 680283 (base 2 -> 3). Command: Abomination 504865 has no SkillLineAbility/CharacterAdvancement row found (unverified acquisition); it is learned directly for mechanics-only testing and falls through DoAction()'s generic entry==50068 branch (AttackSpell/504022), distinct from the Class-tab-gated, jump-casting 504316 on the same minion. The Necromancer raises one Abomination, orders Command: Abomination at a creature, never swings, and the Abomination alone kills it. This bench checks whether the necromancer still gains experience from that kill.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
SETUP: Life Force capacity is raised to 3
Let the Abomination take its formation place and the global cooldown pass
SETUP: the Command cast went through
SETUP: the Abomination kills the creature
BENCH: the commanded kill gives experience
BENCH: the experience did not cross a level
